description:
The love couple of the century, famous for the combination of Aaron, an actor from a slum, and Benny, the only son of a chaebol family, and Suin the cat and Suin, have come to an end. Because Aaron's affair was revealed by the paparazzi! Benny, who prays for the happiness of her ex-husband with a pitiful face, seems like the perfect victim, but... is that the truth? The breakup of the top star couple, and the normal story behind it!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/ex_me_hb/), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/be_your_husband)

**Official Translations:**  
[French](https://www.lezhinfr.com/detail/bt_1110320), [Thai](https://www.lezhinth.com/detail/ex_me_hb), [T.Chinese](https://www.bomtoon.tw/detail/ex_me_hb)
